title: Gateway Energy Storage System: EPA Battery Energy Storage Safety and Incident-Response Considerations
summary: EPA's BESS safety page records the May 2024 Gateway fire, seven days of flareups, monitoring and work-plan requirements during battery handling, and broader incident-response considerations. Entity test: The later official record challenges any assumption that nameplate capacity represented uninterrupted operation.
key_findings: The record supplies an independent incident boundary but does not quantify restored performance.
Alternative-explanation test: Tests operating history, maintenance, safety, and outage-condition alternatives.
Compatibility: Same named asset and incident; the records do not expose a full-capacity availability denominator or compatible dispatch series.
why_it_matters: This record either supplies a later compatible observation or tests a named Phase 56C alternative explanation without turning association into causal proof.
ftfn_relevance: Preserves the Phase 56C parent dossier and stable entity identifier.
Maps the record to named alternative explanations.
Separates observed result, attribution, independent validation, and unresolved denominators.
evidence_limits: A safety and response record cannot be converted into capacity, availability, dispatch, degradation, revenue, or grid-service performance.
Incident and partial-return status are independently attributable; full closure and performance remain unresolved.
No causal effect, ranking, composite score, readiness score, or unsupported cross-entity comparison is supported.
